Yes, you know what every day is a new day, and new things happen and trigger memories and make me think of what could have been at times, but you just got to learn your own brain enough to know when its happening. For the most part I catch it in time and snap out of it, remind myself of that, and look at what's still available now vs shit I might ha e missed out on. Opportunities, or doors you didnt open at the time doesn't necessarily mean it would have been a good thing you never did. It could have been a train wreck. It helps me not dwell too hard, most of the time.

Well this one lady always snuck a guy in her window this way and would greet him wearing topless lingerie, so I got to see boobs like twice a week. It was the best.
They weren't though, similar and surely could be used as such, but each apartment had a back door out the master bedroom and it was a wooden deck style with normal stairs. I wish I had a picture.

Was in school, math class. Seemed a normal day, then the teacher just went really quiet after a phone call and it wasnt much at first. Class went dull and honestly students just started doodling and talking, without the normal hushing from teach. Then the intercom. It was announced that something major was happening and feel free to phone parents and get picked up ect. We were all super confused, every teacher in my school started displaying the news on the class TVs and it got worrisome very quickly. I sat in shock. Over the next few years, I noticed as soon as classmates were of age, a lot of them went for army, brainwashed to take down the middle easterners. I was on the edge of signing up myself but it just never felt like the right thing to do.
